purpose: Allow the API runtime to finalize durable Workforce Administration operation records after the owning business transaction succeeds or fails.
lockImpact: The catalog-only GRANT takes a short permission metadata lock; no application table data or definitions are changed.
dataImpact: No rows are changed. ai_crm_runtime gains UPDATE only on workforce_access.operations so durable commands can record their terminal status and bounded result.
backfill: Not required. Existing pending operation rows remain unchanged and may be retried through their original idempotency key.
recovery: If durable Workforce Administration commands are withdrawn, append a reviewed migration that revokes UPDATE after confirming no API path still finalizes these operation records.
forwardFix: Append a later globally numbered migration to narrow or revoke this exact privilege. Never rewrite this migration after application.
